# VFX Impact and Hit gallery assets

The licensed binary assets in this folder are gitignored.

`effects/`, `models/`, and `textures/` belong under `assets/third_party/vfx_impact_and_hit/`
and are copied from `C:\uworks\AssetsSource\VFX_Impact_and_Hit_1_1_0`. Scene resource paths
are relocated under this folder without changing particle timing, materials, or effect parameters.
